problem_text:
A logistics manager needs to select cargo containers for shipment. Available containers are:
* Container 1: volume 34 m³, revenue $79
* Container 2: volume 3 m³, revenue $51
* Container 3: volume 37 m³, revenue $187
* Container 4: volume 24 m³, revenue $12
* Container 5: volume 5 m³, revenue $107
* Container 6: volume 46 m³, revenue $66
* Container 7: volume 43 m³, revenue $286
* Container 8: volume 31 m³, revenue $32
* Container 9: volume 21 m³, revenue $22
* Container 10: volume 21 m³, revenue $211
* Container 11: volume 9 m³, revenue $150
* Container 12: volume 27 m³, revenue $82
* Container 13: volume 39 m³, revenue $85
The cargo plane has a maximum capacity of 237 m³. Choose the container combination that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this volume limit. Each container is either fully shipped or left behind.
